title: Decay-Resolved Charge Changes from Radioactive Decays in Levitated Microparticles
summary: We measure event-by-event discrete changes in the net electric charge of an optically levitated silica microsphere arising from individual radioactive decays within the sphere, in coincidence with energy depositions in a nearby scintillation detector. The net charge of the levitated sphere is continuously monitored by measuring its driven response to an oscillating electric field, allowing individual charge-change events to be resolved on millisecond timescales with precision below an elementary charge.
